description: This file defines the Allergies class, which models a patient's allergies, implementing the List<Allergy> interface with additional logic for handling allergens and allergy statuses.

classes.name: Allergies
classes.description: Represents patient allergies, managing a list of Allergy objects, allergy statuses, and ensuring no duplicate allergens are added.

methods.name: getAllergyStatus
methods.description: Returns the current allergy status string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an allergy to the list after checking for duplicate allergens; updates status to 'See list'.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an allergy from the list; resets status if list becomes empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all allergies and resets status to 'Unknown'.

methods.name: confirmNoKnownAllergies
methods.description: Sets allergy status to 'No known allergies' if allergy list is empty; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Retrieves an allergy by its ID.

methods.name: containsAllergen
methods.description: Checks if an allergen similar to the given allergy already exists in the list.
